name: com.useorgx/orgx-mcp
title: OrgX MCP — Organizational Memory for AI Agents
description: Organizational memory and agent orchestration for decisions, artifacts, tasks, and projects.

tools.name: orgx_bootstrap
tools.title: Bootstrap OrgX Session
tools.description: Establish OrgX session context, granted scopes, and v2 routing guidance.

tools.name: orgx_search
tools.title: Search OrgX Memory
tools.description: Search OrgX memory and entities; replaces list_entities and query_org_memory for public guidance.

tools.name: orgx_inspect
tools.title: Inspect OrgX Entity
tools.description: Hydrate one OrgX entity with context; replaces get_task_with_context for public guidance.

tools.name: orgx_recommend
tools.title: Recommend Next Action
tools.description: Recommend next actions, morning-brief signals, queue priority, pulses, and snapshots.

tools.name: orgx_write
tools.title: Write OrgX Entity
tools.description: Create or update OrgX entities with canonical snake_case fields.

tools.name: orgx_attach
tools.title: Attach OrgX Proof
tools.description: Attach durable artifacts and proof to existing OrgX entities.

tools.name: orgx_act
tools.title: Run OrgX Lifecycle Action
tools.description: Run lifecycle, validation, completion, delete, dry-run, and proof actions.

tools.name: orgx_plan
tools.title: Manage OrgX Plan
tools.description: Start, resume, improve, edit, or complete tracked OrgX planning sessions.

tools.name: orgx_spawn
tools.title: Spawn OrgX Agent Work
tools.description: Guard, classify, spawn, or hand off specialist OrgX agent work.

tools.name: orgx_decide
tools.title: Manage OrgX Decision
tools.description: Create, remember, list, approve, or reject durable OrgX decisions.

tools.name: orgx_submit_receipt
tools.title: Submit OrgX Receipt
tools.description: Submit durable proof, attribution, quality, or outcome receipts.

tools.name: orgx_emit_activity
tools.title: Emit OrgX Activity
tools.description: Emit append-only execution telemetry without changing durable entity state.

tools.name: approve_decision
tools.title: Approve Decision
tools.description: Approve a pending decision from the decisions widget after explicit confirmation.

tools.name: reject_decision
tools.title: Reject Decision
tools.description: Reject or request changes on a pending decision from the decisions widget.

tools.name: get_agent_status
tools.title: Get Agent Status
tools.description: Render the agent-status widget with active, blocked, and idle agent work.

tools.name: get_initiative_pulse
tools.title: Get Initiative Pulse
tools.description: Render the initiative-pulse widget for health, blockers, milestones, and activity.

tools.name: scaffold_initiative
tools.title: Scaffold Initiative
tools.description: Create a full initiative hierarchy and render the scaffolded-initiative widget.

tools.name: spawn_agent_task
tools.title: Spawn Agent Task
tools.description: Delegate work to an agent and render the task-spawned widget. Supports optional model_tier, provider/model hints, budget_mode, and max_cost_usd controls; omit them for normal OrgX auto-routing.

tools.name: handoff_task
tools.title: Handoff Task
tools.description: Hand off an existing task and render the task-spawned widget for the new assignment.

tools.name: recommend_next_action
tools.title: Recommend Next Action
tools.description: Render search-results style next-action recommendations for prioritization.

tools.name: query_org_memory
tools.title: Query Org Memory
tools.description: Render organizational memory search results in the search-results widget.

tools.name: recall_memory
tools.title: Recall Memory
tools.description: Render recalled memory and prior context in the search-results widget.

tools.name: approve_agent_work
tools.title: Approve Agent Work
tools.description: List, approve, or reject agent approval items through the decisions widget.

tools.name: delegate_agent_task
tools.title: Delegate Agent Task
tools.description: Delegate work through the task-spawned widget using agent-friendly fields.

tools.name: track_project_progress
tools.title: Track Project Progress
tools.description: Render project progress through the initiative-pulse widget.

tools.name: review_artifact
tools.title: Review Artifact
tools.description: Render the artifact-review widget for approval or change requests on deliverables.

tools.name: get_morning_brief
tools.title: Get Morning Brief
tools.description: Render the morning-brief widget with receipts, exceptions, ROI, and value signals.

tools.name: get_operator_chronicle
tools.title: Get Operator Chronicle
tools.description: Read decision chronology, artifacts, PR receipts, priorities, goals, velocity, and reporting gaps for a workspace.

tools.name: consolidate_pr
tools.title: Consolidate Pull Request
tools.description: Generate and persist an orchestration.consolidation_pass receipt for a GitHub pull request.
